axes.note: The corner is screen-left from the balcony side throughout

shots.motivation: Warm window behind Mia; cool blue hour; streetlight flickering on
mustSee: a small figure at the rail

startFrom.note: reverse the camera: from the street looking up

shots.reason: Make her small against the building so the waiting reads as patient and a little lonely.

performance.attitude: Patient and practised: this is a nightly ritual, not an emergency
performance.physical: On tiptoe, chin just over the top rail, both hands on it, weight forward against the rail, otherwise completely still
performance.timing: Still for the whole shot; the stillness is the point

layers.fg: balusters, out of focus in style (lighter line)
layers.mg: Mia leaning, hands on the rail

shots.motivation: Warm rim from the window behind; cool fill from the street
shots.reason: Bring us to her height and her patience; the drifting bars make the frame feel like her lookout.

performance.objective: Be the first to hear it
performance.physical: Leans out towards the corner, cheek close to the rail, both hands on the rail with the fingers of one hand tapping (foley in sound.json), knees soft
performance.timing: The lean holds; the tapping is the only movement
performance.fromPrevious: From still to leaning: the waiting has an edge now

composition.subject: headlight glow at the corner, lower-left third

layers.fg: edge of the rail and Mia's raised shoulder, right

shots.motivation: Headlight beam and the streetlight cutting the blue

continuity.note: Point of view: corner stays screen-left

mustSee: Mia rising on her toes at the frame edge
shots.reason: Her point of view at the moment of hope; hiding the vehicle keeps the twist for the next cut.

performance.physical: Seen only as a shoulder and the edge of her head in the foreground, risen higher on her toes
performance.eyeline: The light at the corner (this is her point of view)
performance.timing: Held; the light does the moving
performance.fromPrevious: Higher on her toes: hope rising

layers.mg: scooter and rider with pizza box

shots.motivation: Pool of streetlight on the scooter
mustSee: a pizza box, clearly square, on the back of the scooter

startFrom.note: new props needed: scooter, box; or an authored diagram insert if props are not ready

shots.reason: The reveal must read instantly: one object, centred, in a pool of light.

performance.attitude: A stranger doing his job, unhurried, unaware he's the twist
performance.physical: Seated on the scooter, braking, one foot down, box upright on the rack, head turned towards the building
performance.fromPrevious: New character; Mia is off screen

composition.subject: Mia, arms up, framed by the lit window

shots.motivation: The window behind her glows warmer: the warmest frame of the film

looks.at: down to the scooter, screen-left and below

startFrom.note: arms raised above the rail; still on tiptoe

shots.reason: The punchline is her body; centring her in the window rhymes with the first shot and gives the longest, warmest hold.

performance.attitude: Unguarded delight, the full reversal of her stillness in shot 1
performance.physical: Both arms straight up above the rail, up on her toes, head tipped back a little, whole body stretched tall
performance.eyeline: Down at the scooter in the street
performance.timing: Arms already up on the first frame: the cut is the jump
performance.fromPrevious: From held stillness to full extension, rhyming with shot 1's framing

notes: Cut on the cue word minus a few frames, so the picture leads the line.
sh4 needs two new props (scooter, pizza box); until then use a simple authored insert.
Axis kept: the corner is screen-left from both sides because sh3 and sh4 are true point-of-view shots from the balcony.
